column1: # Held out. Sentences for scripts/eval-clipboard.sh in the same eight languages as
# clipboard-requests-intl.tsv, written afresh with different wording, plus Swedish, Danish, Finnish,
# Romanian, Hungarian, Greek and Bulgarian, which have no example in OnDeviceRefiner.requestExamples
# at all. P = asks for the clipboard to be pasted, N = does not. Not looked at while tuning the
# examples, and not an example: do not copy a sentence from here into requestExamples. Written by a
# model, not checked by a native speaker of each language, so a miss here may be a mistake in the sentence.
